zh: 把一个子数组向两边扩展，任何值的出现次数都不会减少。
因此只要有某个子数组满足条件，整个数组也一定满足；反过来整个数组都不满足时，任何子数组都不可能满足。答案只可能是 n 或 0。
统计整个数组中每个值的出现次数，取最大次数；若它严格大于 k 就输出 n，否则输出 0。
en: Extending a subarray on either side never lowers the number of times any value occurs in it.
So if any subarray qualifies, the whole array qualifies too; and if the whole array does not, no subarray can. The answer is either n or 0.
Count how often each value occurs in the whole array and take the largest count; print n if it is strictly greater than k, otherwise print 0.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Count frequencies over the whole array. If any frequency exceeds k, the whole array is optimal; otherwise no subarray can qualify.

## Why it works

Extending a range never lowers the occurrence count of any value, so if a valid subarray exists, the full array is valid too. Conversely, when no value occurs more than k times in the full array, no shorter range can exceed k either.

## Complexity

Expected time O(n), extra space O(n).
